title: "The original R Markdown file"
format: html

This is the analysis file from October 2023 that produced the published cohort and Table 1 [@hemmige2024density]. It is kept for comparison: the [differences page](differences.qmd) lists each place where the replication departs from it, and why.

The file is unchanged except that file locations on the analyst's computer are replaced by `<data folder>/`. It is shown below as it would read when knitted, with its prose formatted, but nothing in it is run. Each code chunk is folded under a header giving its number, its label and options from the file (some chunks were set to `eval=FALSE` in 2023 and did not run then either), and its line numbers in the file, so a line cited elsewhere can be found. Click a header to open that chunk, or use **Show All Code** in the **Code** menu at the top of the page to open them all.

::: {.Rcode title="Source file"}
-   [`original/original-analysis-2023-10-20.Rmd`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/original/original-analysis-2023-10-20.Rmd)
:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
source("_site_functions.R")
```

## The file

```{r}
#| echo: false

```
